calls.title: GrowthBook & WGAC POC Scoping
calls.summary: The team outlined a structured four-week plan to implement price testing through SDK integration, covering setup in the first week and testing in subsequent weeks. They confirmed a need to finish before the Optimizely contract ends in September to avoid service gaps. A deterministic hashing method will ensure consistent user experience during experiments. Integration with Snowflake allows for accurate tracking of transaction conversions. The discussion also addressed potential Shopify deployment constraints and the need for engineering validation before finalizing vendor selection between GrowthBook and Intelligence. Pricing tiers for GrowthBook were also debated, with initial contracting discussions targeted for mid-July and necessary preliminary paperwork in progress.
calls.keywords: price testing, Shopify integration, SDK, Snowflake, Proof of Concept, vendor evaluation
